mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are negatively impacted.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) suggests accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE > 6%) and falling payroll employment (PAYEMS YoY < 0%) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS YoY < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where during a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2%), an increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a misalignment between monetary policy and real economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2% and HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of Industrial Production (INDPRO > 105) indicates strong supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105.
